description: Read the business facts a site's fixes are written from, as they stand to be confirmed. Use this before confirming facts, to correct facts already confirmed, or after a confirmation answered facts_changed. Returns `confirm` (each fact with what the site says and what the owner confirmed, `confirmed_at`, and any facts gone stale), `name` (the business name the audits found, for the name fact where the site states none), and `seen`, exactly what the block shows, which confirm_facts sends back unchanged. `seen` is absent when the facts cannot be confirmed yet (`can_confirm` false: the site has not been read). The facts are the owner's to confirm: show them to the owner. Reads only. Requires a Website Auditor subscription ($49/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends) — if the user doesn't have one, call get_sample_audit first to show them the exact output format, free and with no API key.
name: get_fix_facts

confirm.description: The confirm block: each fact with what the site says and what the owner confirmed.

can_confirm.description: False when the site has not been read, so nothing can be confirmed yet.

confirmed.description: What the owner confirmed, or null.

site.description: What the site says for this fact.

stale.description: True when the site changed this fact since the owner confirmed it.

name.description: The business name the audits found, for the name fact where the site states none; empty when none.

seen.description: Absent when the facts cannot be confirmed yet.

title: Facts to confirm
